name: MPEG-2 Mosh

params.help: MPEG-2 quantizer; 0 = encoder default. Higher = blockier smear
params.label: Quantizer

params.help: Frames between keyframes; 0 = one keyframe for the whole clip, so motion accumulates
params.label: GOP size

params.help: Average each motion vector over this many frames; 1 = off
params.label: Average window

params.help: Scale horizontal motion; 100 = unchanged, 0 = sink & rise, negative = reverse
params.label: Horizontal scale (%)

params.help: Constant horizontal drift added to every vector
params.label: Pan X

params.help: Constant vertical drift added to every vector
params.label: Pan Y

steps.name: mosh
steps.script:
# Forced-MV MPEG-2 encode | ffedit mosh | lossless decode, over pipes (no MPEG-2 temp files).
gop=$GB_P_GOP
[ "$gop" -gt 0 ] || gop=max
ffgac -hide_banner -nostdin -loglevel error -i "$GB_IN" -an \
  -mpv_flags +nopimb+forcemv -qscale:v "$GB_P_QSCALE" -g "$gop" -bf 0 -sc_threshold max \
  -vcodec mpeg2video -f rawvideo - \
| ffedit -i - -f mv -s "$GB_ROOT/scripts/mosh.js" \
  -sp "$(jq -c '{tail, h_scale, v_scale, pan_x, pan_y}' "$GB_PARAMS")" -o - \
| ffmpeg -hide_banner -nostdin -loglevel error -f mpegvideo -i - \
  -fflags +bitexact -flags:v +bitexact -map_metadata -1 -map_chapters -1 \
  -c:v ffvhuff -y "$GB_OUT"

summary: Forced-MV MPEG-2 encode + ffedit motion-vector mosh (scripts/mosh.js). Defaults match glitch-loop's mv_average; see Presets for sink-and-rise and pan.
